attchmntText: Pavna Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Pavna Industries Limited confirms no deviation in the use of proceeds from its preferential issue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs. 210.70 crore on January 29, 2025, by issuing 17,72,200 equity shares at Rs. 505 per share and 24,00,000 fully convertible warrants at Rs. 505 per warrant. The balance 75% of the warrant consideration was not received by July 28, 2026, causing the warrants to lapse and Rs. 30.30 crore to be forfeited. Consequently, the total funds received stand at Rs. 119.80 crore. The monitoring agency, CARE Ratings Limited, noted that the reduction in issue size increased the proportion of funds allocated to general corporate purposes beyond the 25% regulatory limit. However, the Board of Directors stated that the utilization of Rs. 38.30 crore for general corporate purposes remains within the approved allocation of Rs. 50.00 crore and is compliant with regulations.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended on September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Pavna Industries Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding its Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Fully Convertible Warrants. The total issue size is Rs. 210.70 crore. CARE Ratings Limited is the Monitoring Agency. The report states that fund utilization aligns with the objects mentioned in the Board Resolution dated January 29, 2025. There are no material deviations or changes in the means of finance. The Monitoring Agency noted that the Company's share price was Rs. 18.41 per share on October 23, 2026, which is lower than the warrant conversion price of Rs. 50.50 per share. Consequently, warrants lapsed and Rs. 30.30 crore was forfeited on July 28, 2026. This reduced the effective fund raise to Rs. 119.80 crore. The Board of Directors stated that General Corporate Purpose utilization of Rs. 38.30 crore is within the approved allocation of Rs. 50.00 crore and complies with SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Pavna Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pavna Industries Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026. The results include a limited review report from Arun Varshney & Associates. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, total income was 775.05 lakhs. Total expenses were 10,617.98 lakhs. Profit before tax was negative 217.12 lakhs. Profit after tax was negative 137.93 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was 1,521.77 lakhs. Total expenses were 19,276.19 lakhs. Profit before tax was negative 78.39 lakhs. Profit after tax was negative 49.19 lakhs. The company will publish these results on its website and in newspapers.
